system.description: You swing your weapon with enough force to create a lateral wave of force. Creatures in a 15-foot cone originating from you must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save you deal your [Weapons damage] + 1d10 and they are knocked Prone on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d10.
